title: filenode-client fixtures still use -14 FileNode wire shape
description: crate-jmap-filenode-client/tests/integration_get_query.rs:27-38,65-66,138 builds FileNode fixtures with "nodeType": "file"/"directory" and "type": null. Line 381-404 asserts a filter of nodeType "file" (lowercase; NodeType is now "File"). src/methods/filenode.rs:703-735 has a set_response test whose fixture cites draft-13 and uses "type": null. After the filenode-types change these keys no longer map to fields (FileNode reads @type and mediaType). The stale keys fall into extra, node_type is None, and the tests still pass, so they no longer test the real wire format. Update the fixtures to the -16 shape (@type PascalCase, mediaType, type-specific properties omitted).
close_reason: fixed in working tree (uncommitted), verified by adversarial reviewer + cargo test
